records.title: 10-Q
records.text: On a pro forma basis, total operating revenue increased $27 million, or 1%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: On a pro forma basis, Passenger revenue was flat, on a 2% increase in yield offset by a 2% decrease in traffic.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Decreased capacity in the third quarter was a response to softening demand.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: On a pro forma basis, total operating expenses increased $185 million, or 5%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cash provided by operating activities was $1.1 billion during the first nine months of 2025.
